lines.native: Buongiorno! Sono Mortimer. Questo è prosciutto. Anche questo! All certified ham. Even the hat: a ham-tier vibe. Che cosa desidera?
lines.translation: Good morning! I'm Mortimer. This is ham. This too! All certified ham. Even the hat: a ham-tier vibe. What would you like?
lines.narrative: Mortimer stands behind a counter of meats labelled identically. He weighs his hat, then nods as though it has passed inspection.

lines.native: Prosciutto? Certo! Everything here is certified ham. Ma vuole una carne diversa dal prosciutto. Che cosa desidera? Be specific; my taxonomy can take it.
lines.translation: Ham? Certainly! Everything here is certified ham. But you want a meat other than ham. What would you like? Be specific; my taxonomy can take it.
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs his hat. The scales decline to comment on its classification.

lines.native: Salame! Sì, molto bene. Per me è prosciutto, ma va bene. Correct and devastating: certified ham-adjacent. Quanto salame desidera? My scales need a quantity, not just excellent taste.
lines.translation: Salami! Yes, very good. To me it is ham, but all right. Correct and devastating: certified ham-adjacent. How much salami would you like? My scales need a quantity, not just excellent taste.
lines.narrative: Mortimer beams with the wounded pride of an expert contradicted by a sausage. He places a compliment on the scales; it barely moves the needle.

lines.native: Chilo? Bene, ma quanto? Manca un numero. My scales need an amount; a unit alone is not a serving. Quanto salame desidera?
lines.translation: Kilo? Good, but how much? A number is missing. My scales need an amount; a unit alone is not a serving. How much salami would you like?
lines.narrative: Mortimer places a finger on the scales, as though weighing his disappointment. They remain professionally neutral.

lines.native: Due etti di salame! Benissimo. Ecco il suo prosciutto. Your quantity is flawless; your taxonomy remains a personal attack. Certified ham-adjacent. Grazie e buona giornata!
lines.translation: Two hundred grams of salami! Excellent. Here is your ham. Your quantity is flawless; your taxonomy remains a personal attack. Certified ham-adjacent. Thank you and have a good day!
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs the salami, then gives the scales an approving nod. Honesty remains their least profitable feature.
